The regions are:

- \(X\): inner circle of radius \(4\)  
  \[
  A_X=\pi(4^2)=16\pi
  \]

- \(Y\): annulus between radii \(4\) and \(6\)  
  \[
  A_Y=\pi(6^2-4^2)=\pi(36-16)=20\pi
  \]

- \(Z\): annulus between radii \(6\) and \(7\)  
  \[
  A_Z=\pi(7^2-6^2)=\pi(49-36)=13\pi
  \]

The greatest area is \(20\pi\), and the smallest area is \(13\pi\).  
Their difference is:
\[
20\pi-13\pi=7\pi
\]

The answer is \(\boxed{7\pi}\).
